verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents built-in agentic capabilities: native function calling/agentic web search, tool approval workflows, delegating to parallel sub-agents via delegate_task, scheduled autonomous tasks, and skills the AI can invoke on demand — all delegated to a built-in assistant inside the product itself. This is well-documented first-party evidence across multiple features (docs-10, docs-41, docs-31, docs-37, docs-11). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of agentic task delegation (community evidence only covers RAG/UI complaints, not the agent-delegation features), and no evidence of real-world reliability at scale for sub-agent delegation.
